title: Annoying pop-up
body: I liked it until an “offer” pops up every time I open the app to upgrade to premium.
author: Mateee52

title: Overpriced
body:
App description say: you do not need to pay a penny to build as many habit as you want. However i can not add new habit unless i pay the premium.
Otherwise i really liked the app it is defenetly worth 5000huf however 15.500 huf is a little but overpriced i think, and it looks like i can not use the app at all if i do not pay :( this is the reason behind 3 stars.
author: kamcika
